1. (Currently Amended) A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating __the__ one or more embryos in a __medium that does not harm embryo viability__; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos.

2. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the non-destructive medium consists essentially of __an aqueous solution__. 

7. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with __a non-destructive enzyme__. 

11. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more __viable immature embryos__.

12. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos __in a quiescent state__ prior to step (c) or (d).

13. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is __performed via genotyping techniques__.

17. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 13 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on __the results of the molecular analysis performed__. 

18. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __after assessment of their genotypes__. 

19. (Currently Amended) The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos is __performed using a computer automated process__.
